blurb: Suisun Creek Winery is a family owned and operated winery and vineyard with a history of four generations of grape growers. Guests can visit the winery for tastings available Saturdays and Sundays from noon to 5pm with no reservations necessary. The winery is located on a family property farmed for over 40 years, producing handcrafted wines by their winemaker Brian.
extraNote: Orders by credit card only: Visa, MasterCard, American Express accepted · Wine shipments require signature of sober adult 21 or older · No minimum purchase required · Shipping via FedEx Ground at current market rates; customer pays all shipping charges if FedEx Air selected
